newsitem.title: CHINA: China banks in 565 million yuan power plant loan.
newsitem.headline: China banks in 565 million yuan power plant loan.

text.p: China's State Development Bank and the Bank of China have jointly provided a loan of 565 million yuan to Xiangfan Power Ltd in central Hubei province, a provincial power official said on Monday.
The agreement signing ceremony was held on March 21 in the provincial capital Wuhan, he said by telephone from Wuhan.
Hubei has seen a shortage of electricity for the last 10 years and there was unlikely to be any real easing in the shortfall for three to four years, he said.

The money would mainly be used in the construction of the 1,200-megawatt power plant and its subsidiary generating plants, and sending electricity plants. The plant is due for completion in 1999, the official said.
